title: Astro Marketing Foundation
notes: Add a standalone Astro marketing frontend under /marketing while preserving the existing React/Vite operations application.
Build a custom industrial Northborn visual system instead of a generic SaaS card-template homepage.
Add a GSAP ScrollTrigger request-to-revenue story that follows one job through request, dispatch, field, signed ticket and billing.
Add React + Motion Manager, Operator and Client product views with real interactive state transitions.
Add a selective Three.js desktop field-network visual with reduced-motion and mobile fallbacks.
Add an independent marketing CI workflow for Astro type checking and static production builds.
Keep the marketing frontend ready for a future custom Rive asset without loading a generic stock animation.
